# Interview Q&A — all questions by topic

Every topic on this site has documentation **and** a questions-and-answers section. This page lists every question, grouped by topic and tagged with one of three importance levels, so you can decide what to study first.

> Question bank last revised: 22 November 2026 · Reference versions: Go 1.27, PHP 8.6, PostgreSQL 19, Kafka 4.2, RabbitMQ 4.x, OWASP Top 10:2025

## How to use it

- Each question has an answer, a real-world example, a use case and sometimes an **interview trap**.
- For self-testing, press **Close all** on a topic page and open the answers one by one.
- Short on time? Use the level filter on each page and do the **Must-know** questions first, then **Important**.
- Pages marked *Lessons + Q&A* start with a lesson; the other pages are full docs that end with a Q&A section.

## Importance levels

- <Badge type="danger" text="Must-know" /> asked in almost every interview; you meet it at work constantly
- <Badge type="warning" text="Important" /> frequent; expected at senior level
- <Badge type="info" text="Good to know" /> extra depth that sets you apart
